finding: Q23 proposes that deterministic/feature-level visual processing and optional EAP ActiveAssembly remain local until uncertainty, novelty, conflict or task criticality makes global broadcast useful. False GWT ignition from wrong associative memory is now an explicit fault-injection metric.
counterhypotheses: The additional pre-GWT retrieval/controller layers may delay useful broadcast or hide critical visual changes.
Wrong associative context may increase false ignition instead of reducing global load.
required_validation: Measure false_GWT_ignition and sensor_override_failure under wrong/stale seeds.
Compare end-to-end task success/latency against direct Qwen/GWT and direct-memory baselines.
ancestry_policy: Q23 changes are one coordinated lineage, not independent replication
